required.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period.

available.quote: The board may issue a license upon payment of a fee, set by the board under section 13 of this chapter, to an applicant who furnishes proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant is a dentist who: (1) is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application

requirements.value: Licensed in another state or Canadian province with substantially equal requirements; practiced dentistry for at least 2 of the 3 preceding years; passes law examination; completed required CE hours in previous 2 years; meets all other requirements.
requirements.quote: is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application; (2) has practiced dentistry for at least two (2) of the three (3) years preceding the date of application; (3) passes the law examination administered by the board or an entity approved by the board; (4) has completed the required hours of continuing education in the previous two (2) years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without a valid license is a Level 6 felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or hiring an unlicensed person to practice dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ, hire, or procure one who is not duly licensed as a dentist to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, bartering, or issuing a dental degree, license, diploma or document without authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sell or barter, or offer to sell or barter, or, not being lawfully authorized so to do, issue or confer, or offer to issue or confer, any dental degree, license, or any diploma or document conferring, or purporting to confer, any dental degree or license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchasing or procuring by barter any diploma, license, certificate, or transcript with intent to use as fraudulent evidence of qualifications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purchase, or procure by barter, any diploma, license, certificate, or transcript, with intent that it be used as evidence of the qualifications to practice dentistry of any person other than the one upon, or to whom, it was lawfully conferred or issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered diploma or certificate as a license to practice dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any diploma, certificate, or transcript which has been purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered, either as a license or color of license, to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under a false name or under another person's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry under a false name, under a name intended to mislead the public, under the license of another person of the same name, or hold the person out to the public under such a name as a practitioner of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assuming the title of dental degree without having the degree conferred.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assume the title or degree of "Bachelor of Dental Surgery", append the letters "B.D.S.", "D.D.S.", "M.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", to the person's name, or make use of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that one is entitled to practice dentistry without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not having been licensed to practice dentistry under the laws of this state, represent that the person is entitled so to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating another at an examination for dental candidates.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely personate another at any examination to ascertain the preliminary professional education of candidates for dental certificates, dental degrees, or dental licenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the practice act or rules adopted thereunder subjects a licensee to discipline.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An individual who: (1) is licensed under; and (2) fails to comply with; this article or rules adopted under this article is subject to discipline under IC 25-1-9.

insurance_required.quote: An applicant must provide proof that either: (A) the individual; or (B) the clinic at which the individual will practice; has malpractice insurance that covers the individual.

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word 'dentist' or 'dental surgeon', the letters 'D.D.S.' or 'D.M.D.', or other letters or titles in connection with dentistry. ... (4) Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area; ... using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures. (5) Extracts human teeth or corrects malpositions of the teeth or jaws.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist or dental assistant ... may administer nitrous oxide under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist if the dental hygienist or dental assistant has: (1) been employed in a dental practice for at least one (1) year or has graduated from a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association; (2) satisfactorily completed a three (3) hour didactic nitrous oxide administration course
